memory_candidates.title: Route a Los lemma through a first-order truth predicate, not the modal one
memory_candidates.body: When a modal truth predicate quantifies over a non-pointwise-definable family (e.g. TruthAt's box over all total world-histories), do not prove Los for it directly. If the tree already has a representation theorem to an equivalent predicate whose box quantifies over a carrier sort (ShiftTruth over S.Carrier), prove Los there and conjugate by the representation theorem. The hard choice-function argument disappears because it was already discharged inside the representation theorem.

memory_candidates.title: Eventual-existential choice needs a junk value, so Classical.skolem does not apply
memory_candidates.body: Extracting a global section from `∀ᶠ i in phi, ∃ v, P i v` is NOT Classical.skolem or Classical.axiomOfChoice: those need a total `∀ i, ∃ v`. The section must be total, so off-filter indices need Classical.arbitrary and the family needs a [∀ i, Nonempty (Omega i)] binder. Pattern: `fun i => if hi : ∃ v, P i v then hi.choose else Classical.arbitrary _`, then `h.mono (fun i hi => by simp only [dif_pos hi]; exact hi.choose_spec)`.

memory_candidates.title: @[reducible] on a bundled-structure constructor is load-bearing for rw motive typing
memory_candidates.body: A `noncomputable def X : TemporalOrder := TemporalOrder.of Y` blocks `rw` inside proofs whose goals mention `(X ...).carrier`: the projection will not reduce to Y at motive-typing transparency and rw fails with 'Application type mismatch ... expected to have type (X ...).carrier'. Mark such definitions @[reducible]. Separately, rw through a plain (semireducible) structure-valued def's fields fails the same way; use Iff.trans / exact, which check at default transparency.
